result.guidanceOfficial: Q4 2026 Revenue is expected to range between 6,000 萬美元 and 7,500 萬美元；Q4 2026 Net loss is expected to range between 1,100 萬美元 and 800 萬美元；Q4 2026 Net loss per share is expected to range between $0.13 and $0.10；Q4 2026 Adjusted EBITDA is expected to range between 500 萬美元 and 1,300 萬美元，which excludes an estimated 500 萬美元 to 1,000 萬美元 of East Providence incident-related costs；FY 2026 Capital Expenditures，excluding costs related to the restoration of the East Providence facility，are expected to be less than 1,000 萬美元。
